summary: Old operator domain is spam; the operator now books through a SiteMinder direct-book page (the Google listing's 'Official site'). Fees set $42.80-$53.50 (engine Standard Rate with tax; posted $40 30-amp / $50 50-amp), 2026 and 2027 the same; electric 50 and pull-through confirmed; laundry confirmed, wifi added; military 10% (active duty) added; booking via the direct-book engine. Cleared water/sewer, site count and dump (no current operator source). Season year_round left (no current statement either way). Note rewritten. 14474 is a duplicate; 2631's pin is wrong (see flags).
flags: DUPLICATE: 14474 is the same park as 2631 - same name, same phone 719-873-5595, same address 27680 US-160, South Fork; the Google listing and the booking engine describe one property. 14474 should be removed (its Good Sam discounts.good_sam false is moot; military is now set on 2631 from the operator's own policy).

RE-PIN 2631: the stored pin 37.66790,-106.64279 is inside South Fork town (commercial buildings), about 4.4 km west of the park. The RV rows sit south of US-160 against the bluff, east of the lodge, at about 37.6762,-106.5922 (Google's pin 37.6764,-106.5929 = 14474's pin, on the lodge, ~60 m from the rows). Move 2631 to ~37.6762,-106.5922; re-take elevation (14474 has 2484 m vs 2631's 2505 m).

WEBSITE: uteblufflodge.com is compromised (redirects to unrelated gambling spam). Replace with the operator's booking page https://direct-book.com/properties/UteBluffLodgeCabinRVParkDIRECT (no other operator site found).

US$50 gate: the 30-amp back-in site is posted $40 and quotes $42.80 with tax in the engine for October 2026 and June 2027; 50-amp $50 / $53.50. A 30-amp site fits EKKO, so it passes. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Great Sand Dunes NP ~100 km); the family has not stayed here.

Presence: Google Maps open, 4.4 over 149 reviews, phone (719) 873-5595, plus a working booking engine selling RV sites nightly. Passes. Weekly/monthly rates offered, but nightly sites are sold online - not long-stay in character.
The property has been listed for sale (~$2.5M, '27 RV sites, 22 lodge rooms, 6 cabins, 17.5 acres') in broker listings; it is still operating and taking bookings for 2027.

Hookups: the old operator site (gone) said 30 full-hookup sites; current operator pages say only 30/50-amp electric, so water/sewer were cleared rather than kept on a dead source. A phone call would settle it.
Waterfront 'not waterfront' is right: the Rio Grande runs on the north side of US-160, ~150 m from the RV rows; the operator calls it a 'River Drop-in area located just across the street'.
